[Intro]
[Am]

[Verse 1]
[Am]Time, time, time
See what's be-
[G]come of me
While I
[F]looked around
for my possi-
[G6]bilities
I was so
[G]hard to please
But look around

[Chorus]
[Am]Leaves are brown
[G]And the sky
[F]is a hazy
[E]shade of win-

[Verse 2]
[Am]ter
Hear the salvation
[G]army band
[F]Down by the riverside's,
Bound to be a better ride Than
[G6]what you've got planned
Carry your
[G]cup in your hand
And look around

[Chorus]
[Am]Leaves are brown
[G]now And the sky
[F]is a ha-
[E]zy shade of win-

[Verse 3]
[Am]ter
Hang on to your hopes,
[G]my friend
[F]That's an easy thing to say But
if your hope should pass away
[G6]Simply pretend
That you can
[G]build them again
Look around

[Chorus]
[Am]The grass is
[G]high The fields are
[F]ripe It's the spring-
[E]time of my life
[Am]

[Bridge]
[F]Ahhh,
seasons change with the
[C]scenery
Weaving time in a
[G]tapestry
Won't you stop and re-
[Am]member me
[G]At any conven-
ient time?

[Verse 4]
[F]Funny how my memory skips
While looking over manuscripts Of
[G6]unpublished rhyme
Drinking my
[G]vodka and lime
I look around

[Chorus]
[Am]Leaves are brown
[G]now And the sky
[F]is a hazy
[E]shade of win-

[Outro]
[Am]ter I look a-
[G]round Leaves are brown
[F]There's a patch
[E]of snow on the ground...
